scope: 97 exact source copies plus overlay navigation/status additions. No re-approval of mathematics, full predecessor tree, future additions or final Git/ACK state.
findings: No conversational transcript contents or encoded raw observation payloads found in exact additions.
The contributor matrix contains attribution and evidence metadata, not copied conversations.
Original manifests refer to omitted private artifacts; README explicitly states that they are selection manifests, not complete public bundles.

Only absolute local paths found by scan are in author payload CHECKS and contributor INPUT-PINS; these are artifact references, not copied logs or credentials. They may remain as original evidence metadata; do not rewrite hash-pinned originals.
Pending namespace templates and tests contain identifiers, empty/pending trusted fields and synthetic fixture values, not actual signing keys or protected state exports.
No new third-party PDF, source scan, archive, or unrelated binary is present. Literature metadata and scoped mathematical assertions are not copies of paywalled source files.
category_exclusions: Any original rollout*.jsonl or copied raw session records
Any CANDIDATES-PRIVATE.json, raw scan output, or original-record payload copied from private provenance working directories
Actual key files, tokens, protected state exports and private/paywalled source PDFs
safe_reference_policy: Publish compact receipt/manifest hashes and scope summaries for omitted private evidence. Do not publish event payload files merely because their base64 is machine-readable; decode before distribution review. Any new public sanitized derivative must have its own path/hash and preserve original privately.
remaining: GI final combined overlay and final D/C/author adoption are not this exact reviewed snapshot; review their actual delta before claiming distribution acceptance.
